subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Mina's grandfather made tea slowly.”?
options: He explained that hot water could make some tea bitter.
Their teacher explained that ocean water can carry things for a long distance.
The homework was not meant to make students love money.
A good change should not make anyone feel locked outside.
